title: Addition Worksheets Within 20
intro: Help your student move from counting every object to counting on or making ten.
html:
Teaching notes for parents and teachers

How to teach it

Start with eight counters, then add five. Model counting on from eight, and show how moving two of the new counters makes a group of ten.

Example to work through together

Use the model below as you explain the example. Have your student point to the quantities as you discuss them.

Count on from 8:

9 → 10 → 11 → 12 → 13

Five counting steps lead to 13, so 8 + 5 = 13.

Ask your student

Which two counters could we move to make ten?

If your student needs help

If the student counts eight as the first new counter, point to the next counter and say nine. Have them count the five added counters again.
